plugins.name: feature
plugins.description: Zero-trust feature implementation team -- intake, research, plan, review, implement, test, and verify new features with eight specialized agents and eight slash commands. Multi-stage evidence-backed gates before any code is written. Persistent state survives /clear and context resets.

commands.name: continue
commands.description: Resume a paused research run from the last STATUS: PARTIAL marker.

commands.name: implement
commands.description: Implement one approved step through implementer -> test-engineer -> step-verifier.

commands.name: init
commands.description: Bootstrap a zero-trust feature implementation. Collect requirements, write task.json, and stage the project for research.

commands.name: plan
commands.description: Build the ordered implementation plan from the confirmed task and complete research.

commands.name: research
commands.description: Research the codebase area-by-area against the confirmed task. One area per turn, stops on STATUS: PARTIAL.

commands.name: review
commands.description: Independent review of the plan, plus user approval. The final gate before any code is written.
headings: When the critic and user disagree

commands.name: status
commands.description: Show current feature progress, pre-implementation gate state, step status, and next recommended action.

commands.name: summary
commands.description: Produce the final feature implementation report. Only valid when every step is in a terminal state and every AC is delivered or explicitly accepted as undelivered.

headings: Why every state file is plain text
